$comment: Numbers every evidence run is judged by, fixed before any result exists. Changing this file needs a reason in the commit message. The big-run harness (#45) will refuse an official run if the file changed since its own commit. Sources: issues #19 (big run, load test), #13 (fault scope), #20 (cache run, world dataset).

duplicateTiming.$comment: Same Idempotency-Key, byte-identical body. Delayed = 0.5-10s after the original's 202. Late = after the case completed, still inside the 24h key retention.

eventMix.$comment: Seeded, fixed shares of visits; the rest is happy path. Out of order = one event sent before its predecessor. Fallback person lookup = mother's NIK or name+birthDate+gender.

faults.$comment: One PUT /__mock/faults with bigRun.seed. Weights are percent of every call in the group. Token endpoint excluded; http_400/http_401 never injected.

reads.match: GET and search on FHIR, and every KFA call

topology.$comment: CPU/memory limits per container. compose.yaml must carry exactly these once the services exist there; the report captures the limits it actually ran with.

reconciliation.$comment: Periodic reconciliation off. One on-demand run after the drain; its counts are information, not a pass criterion.

invariants.$comment: PASS only if every invariant holds, checked hub side and mock side against the manifest written before the first send.

cacheRun.$comment: Big-run harness and event mix with faults off. Mock latencies are assumed constants, not sandbox measurements. A cache that misses any bar is removed from the code; its result stays published.

barToStay.$comment: Per cache, against the arm without it.
